summary: Every rendered number on report.md, dashboard_data.json and the manifest matches its claim and display_digits (60 of 60, agreeing with gate_release_machine), and I recomputed the headline and channel figures independently from the metrics registry. They reconcile: 1,971,306.75 + 1,051,989.86 = 3,023,296.61 net revenue; 24,597 + 19,934 = 44,531 orders; the Wilson bounds, the z test and the effect match exactly; Welch t and Cohen's d are consistent within rounding. The release still fails on what surrounds the numbers. (1) The page-level population line says 'delivered only' for the whole report
